Tasya bhūmiṣu viniyogaḥ /III.6/
Tasya bhūmiṣu viniyogaḥ /III.6/

« On applique ce [saṃyama] successivement à tous les plans. »
1408

Tasya saṃyamasya jita-bhūmer yā–anantarā bhūmis tatra viniyogaḥ / Na hy ajita-adhara-
bhūmir anantara-bhūmiṃ vilaṅghya prānta-bhūmiṣu saṃyamaṃ labhate / Tad-abhāvāc ca
kutas tasya prajñā-ālokaḥ ? Īśvara-prasādāj jita-uttara-bhūmikasya ca na–adhara-bhūmiṣu
para-citta-jñāna-ādiṣu saṃyamo yuktaḥ / Kasmāt ? Tad-arthasya–anyata eva–avagatatvāt /
Bhūmer asyā iyam anantarā bhūmir ity atra yoga eva–upādhyāyaḥ / Katham ? Evaṃ hy
uktam--
Yogena yogo jñātavyo yogo yogāt pravartate /
Yo'pramattas tu yogena sa yoge ramate ciram / iti /6/
